def fn(x):

    qwerty = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"

def fn(x):
    # QWERTY substitution mapping
    qwerty = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"
    alphabet = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    lower_map = {a: q for a, q in zip(alphabet, qwerty)}

    upper_map = {k.upper(): v.upper() for k, v in lower_map.items()}
    # Merge both dictionaries

def fn(x):

    qwerty = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"

def fn(x):

    qwerty = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"

def fn(x):

    qwerty = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"

def fn(x):
    # QWERTY substitution mapping
    qwerty = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"
    alphabet = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    lower_map = {a: q for a, q in zip(alphabet, qwerty)}
    # Build upper‑case map
    upper_map = {k.upper(): v.upper() for k, v in lower_map.items()}
    # Merge both dictionaries
    trans = {**lower_map, **upper_map}

    # Translate the string
    return "".join(trans.get(ch, ch) for ch in x)

def fn(x):
    # QWERTY substitution mapping
    qwerty = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"
    alphabet = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    lower_map = {a: q for a, q in zip(alphabet, qwerty)}
    # Build upper‑case map
    upper_map = {k.upper(): v.upper() for k, v in lower_map.items()}
    # Merge both dictionaries
    trans = {**lower_map, **upper_map}

    # Translate the string
    return "".join(trans.get(ch, ch) for ch in x)

def fn(x):
    # QWERTY substitution mapping
    qwerty = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"
    alphabet = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    lower_map = {a: q for a, q in zip(alphabet, qwerty)}

    upper_map = {k.upper(): v.upper() for k, v in lower_map.items()}
    # Merge both dictionaries
    trans = {**lower_map, **upper_map}

    # Translate the string
    return "".join(trans.get(ch, ch) for ch in x)

def fn(x):
    # QWERTY substitution mapping
    qwerty = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"
    alphabet = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    lower_map = {a: q for a, q in zip(alphabet, qwerty)}
    # Build upper‑case map
    upper_map = {k.upper(): v.upper() for k, v in lower_map.items()}
    # Merge both dictionaries
    trans = {**lower_map, **upper_map}

    # Translate the string
    return "".join(trans.get(ch, ch) for ch in x)
